built.heading: What we built. Why it works.
built.intro: Two thousand years of human reflection on the questions that matter, examined through modern research, made accessible through AI. All for one purpose: helping you see what you couldn't see alone.
built.easternBody:
For two thousand years, Eastern philosophical traditions have examined the questions humans keep asking — about decision, direction, and the patterns that shape a life.

Career. Love. Direction. Doubt.

These traditions weren't about fixed predictions. They were frameworks for thinking — refined over eighty generations of human experience.
built.modernBody:
What ancient observation noticed, modern research is beginning to measure.

Cognitive science on how we frame decisions. Spatial psychology on attention. Circadian biology on natural rhythm. Behavioral economics on cognitive bias.

The frameworks that worked for millennia, now examined through contemporary research.
built.aiBody:
We took the frameworks these traditions developed. We added what modern research has examined. We gave it to AI — to respond to your specific question, in your specific moment.

Not to replace your judgment. To return the conversation to you.

These tools are designed for self-reflection and personal exploration — not for predicting outcomes, diagnosing conditions, or providing professional advice.
built.closingHeading: This is what pojulife is for.
built.closingBody: The questions that matter, met with the depth they deserve — across two millennia of human reflection, the rigor of modern research, and the immediacy of AI.

on_the_cards.heading: On the cards.
paragraphs: The five glyphs are not luck labels. They are not "good cards" or "bad cards."
Each one is a lens — a way of reading this particular moment, for this particular question, held by this particular person.
The same glyph can mean entirely different things on different days, for different people, about different questions.
What you receive is not a verdict. It is a perspective — and an invitation to look more carefully.

home.tagline: Two charts. One relationship. Real clarity.
home.description: Match weaves both bazi foundations together — yours and theirs — to reveal how your energies align, where you support each other, where you collide, and what to do about it.
home.free_note: First Match free. After that, $4.99 per reading.
home.feature_two_charts_desc: Deep individual readings of both people, then a layered analysis of how you meet.
home.feature_any_relationship_desc: Marriage, partnership, family, friendship, work — describe it in your own words and we read it.
home.feature_5_sections_desc: 5 sections: each of you, together, conclusion, and clear actionable recommendations.
home.how_title: From two charts to one clear path — in 4 steps.
home.how_step_1_desc: Choose a bazi from your library or add a new one. Just date, time, and gender.
home.how_step_2_desc: Same flow. B's chart is saved to your library so you can run more matches later.
home.how_step_3_desc: In your own words — current, intended, or in question. The more specific, the deeper the reading.
home.how_step_4_desc: 5 expandable cards. Saved to your Archive so you can return anytime within your access.
home.use_case_marriage_desc: Considering commitment? See what the charts say about long-term alignment.
home.use_case_partnership_desc: Evaluate co-founders, business partners, or key collaborators before you sign.
home.use_case_family_desc: Understand difficult family relationships — parent, child, sibling, in-law.
home.use_case_hiring_desc: Read the energetic fit between you and a key hire or new team member.
home.use_case_relationship_desc: Stuck in tension with someone? See what's structural and what's surface.
home.use_case_friendship_desc: Why some friendships flow and others fade — the charts often have the answer.
home.preview_a_desc: Their natural traits, tendencies, and what they bring to this relationship.
home.preview_b_desc: Same depth for the other person — their patterns in this kind of connection.
home.preview_combined_desc: Five-element interactions, ten-god dynamics, timing alignment — the full layered analysis.
home.preview_conclusion_desc: Overall compatibility level (1 of 5 tiers), plus your strengths and challenges together.
home.preview_actions_desc: 4-6 specific, actionable recommendations — communication, timing, boundaries, growth.
home.include_1: Full bazi analysis of both people
home.first_free_emphasized: Your first Match is free. No card required.
home.faq_q1: What if I don't know the other person's birth time?
home.faq_a1: You can still run a Match with approximate time — accuracy is slightly reduced but the core analysis remains valuable. We use 2-hour windows (Chinese hour periods), so even a rough estimate works.
home.faq_q2: Does the other person need to consent or know?
home.faq_a2: Match is for your understanding. The other person doesn't need to be involved. We never contact them, share their data, or reveal that you ran the reading. Their chart stays on your device only.
home.faq_q3: Can I do more than two people at once?
home.faq_a3: Currently Match focuses on two-person dynamics — this keeps the reading deep and clear. For complex situations (e.g., you + spouse + parent), we suggest running separate Matches to map each relationship cleanly.
home.faq_q4: How is this different from POJU?
home.faq_a4: POJU is a 30-day deep conversation about your situation. Match is a one-time, focused two-chart reading about a specific relationship. Different tools for different needs — many users use both.
home.not_footer: Match offers perspectives, not predictions. What you do with them is entirely yours.
